title: Simple death ban
description: Adds a 5 min deathban thats toggelable and bypassable.
body:
A lightweight Fabric server mod that adds temporary death bans with simple moderation commands.
Players are banned for 5 minutes when they die.
Toggle the system on or off at any time.
Permission-protected admin commands.
Prevents banned players from rejoining until their timer expires.
Unban players manually.
Grant deathban immunity to selected players.
